title: Five Candles in the Meadow
author: Harley D.

archive.primary: Five Candles in the Meadow by harley d.html

description:
Five Candles in the Meadow is a game about sending letters to your best friend who lives on the other side of known space, with a growing conflict among the stars between you and them.

This project was originally created for the 2024 Dialogue Game Jam, the theme in which every submission could only use dialogue to convey the story, with little to no descriptive text. This project was delayed for several months, but better late than never.
